info.title: CargaExpress Supply Chain API
info.description: CargaExpress Control Tower Logistics: APIs for WMS order orchestration, carrier tracking, dynamic state mapping, and exception management.

get.description: Check service availability and report database connection status. Always returns HTTP 200 with connectivity detail (up/down).

200.description: Service health status and database connectivity.

post.description:
Receive push tracking events from Type A carrier webhooks (F3 / RNF-01 / NFR-06).

Decodes heterogeneous payloads and publishes to RabbitMQ queue `eventos_transportadora`
for asynchronous processing, guaranteeing response time < 200 ms (RNF-01).
Protected by token or HMAC signature verification (NFR-06).

schema.title: Response Receive Carrier Webhook Api V1 Webhooks  Carrier Slug  Post

post.description:
Trigger periodic polling connector for Type A simulator receiver (F3 Airflow batch hook).

Queries simulator receiver REST APIs, normalizes tracking statuses into canonical states,
and updates WMS database with RN-01 and RN-02 compliance.

parameters.name: carrier_slug

schema.description: Optional carrier slug (alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon). If omitted, syncs all 5 carriers.
schema.title: Carrier Slug

parameters.description: Optional carrier slug (alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon). If omitted, syncs all 5 carriers.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Max events to pull per carrier.
schema.title: Limit

schema.title: Response Trigger Type A Sync Api V1 Sync Type A Post

post.description:
Trigger periodic polling connector for Type B carriers (F4 / Airflow batch hook).

Queries carrier REST APIs, respects rate limits with exponential backoff,
and passes all tracking events through NormalizationService (RN-01 / RN-02).

parameters.name: carrier_name

schema.description: Optional carrier name to sync. If omitted, syncs all 4 Type B carriers.
schema.title: Carrier Name

parameters.description: Optional carrier name to sync. If omitted, syncs all 4 Type B carriers.

schema.title: Response Trigger Type B Sync Api V1 Sync Type B Post

post.description:
Trigger pull synchronization for Type C batch files from carrier endpoints and MinIO S3.

Downloads newly generated CSV/Excel files from Carrier servers or MinIO S3 bucket,
deduplicates against previously ingested files, and normalizes events to canonical states.

parameters.name: carrier_name

schema.description: Optional carrier name. If omitted, synchronizes all Type C sources.
schema.title: Carrier Name

parameters.description: Optional carrier name. If omitted, synchronizes all Type C sources.

Trigger pull synchronization for Type C batch files from carrier endpoints and MinIO S3.

Downloads newly generated CSV/Excel files from Carrier servers or MinIO S3 bucket,
deduplicates against previously ingested files, and normalizes events to canonical states.

parameters.name: carrier_name

schema.title: Response Trigger Type C Sync Api V1 Sync Type C Post

post.description:
Upload and ingest a Type C batch file (CSV or Excel).

Cleans known defects (repeated headers, total/summary rows),
prevents duplicate ingestion via SHA-256 and filename tracking,
and normalizes all valid tracking events using NormalizationService.

schema.title: Response Upload Type C File Api V1 Sync Type C Upload Post
